tasks.label: Swerve simulation for Elastic
tasks.command: $localJdk = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\RobotCodeTools" -Directory -Filter 'jdk-25*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $localJdk) { throw 'Java 25 not found in %LOCALAPPDATA%\RobotCodeTools. Install the project Java 25 toolchain before launching the simulator.' }; $env:JAVA_HOME = $localJdk.FullName; & .\gradlew.bat run -PswerveSim --no-daemon --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Simulate TalonFX swerve (terminal)
tasks.command: $localJdk = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\RobotCodeTools" -Directory -Filter 'jdk-25*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $localJdk) { throw 'Java 25 not found in %LOCALAPPDATA%\RobotCodeTools. Install the project Java 25 toolchain before running tests.' }; $env:JAVA_HOME = $localJdk.FullName; & .\gradlew.bat test --tests frc.robot.subsystems.SimTalonFXDrivetrainTest --no-daemon --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
